summary: Iteration 2 testing of NexusOS extended CRM/Invoicing/Payments/Inventory features. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests passed (21 regression from iter1 + 11 new for leads CRUD+convert, customer history/list totals, dashboard extended KPIs, invoice status transitions incl. draft->sent->overdue->paid, invoice detail with payments+balance, employees CRUD, tasks with customer link, payments error cases, and the CRITICAL end-to-end workflow: customer -> product(stock 50) -> invoice(qty 10, 10%% discount) -> stock deducted to 40 -> partial payment -> partially_paid -> mark paid -> paid + balance 0 + customer outstanding 0 + dashboard amount_collected reflects). Frontend Playwright: login+demo-fill lands on Dashboard showing all 4 new KPIs (Amount Collected $34,638.77, Overdue $3,520.26, New Customers 2, Open Tasks 7) plus sales-by-category and invoice-status charts; Leads pipeline board renders all 5 stages and lead-create modal creates a card; Customers list shows Total Sales + Outstanding columns and row-click opens /customers/:id detail; Invoices list tab filters present, row-click opens /invoices/:id showing line items with discounts, totals breakdown (subtotal/tax/total/paid/balance) and payment history; Record Payment modal on invoice detail successfully applies partial payment ($2,021.76 -> $2,011.76 = -$10 as entered); Tasks board/list toggle works and priority filter renders; Employees row-click opens /employees/:id; session persists on reload.

issues: data-testid is 'theme-toggle-button' (from Header.js) — matches implementation; the task hint mentioned 'theme toggle' generically. No bug, note for future tests.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py customer_history returns flat total_sales/outstanding/total_paid (not nested under 'totals'). Frontend CustomerDetail.js must consume this flat shape — verified aligned via UI navigation but worth documenting for API consumers.

Leads convert endpoint (POST /api/leads/{id}/convert) creates a new customer even if a lead with same email already exists as customer — no dedupe. Consider merging by email to avoid duplicate customers.

Invoice `_deduct_inventory` deducts stock also when draft->sent status change AND on create-as-sent; both paths guarded but idempotency across repeated status flips (sent->draft->sent) not tracked — could double-deduct. Recommend a boolean flag `inventory_deducted` on invoice doc.
Dashboard stats loads full invoices/expenses/payments/products/tasks collections (up to 5000 each) per request. For org with high volume this is expensive; consider Mongo aggregations.
